chapters.label: 01 / FACES
chapters.title: Twelve pentagrams
chapters.body: Each face traces a five-pointed star. The crossings inside a pentagram are not extra vertices.

chapters.label: 02 / VERTICES
chapters.title: Five stars meet
chapters.body: Five pentagram faces meet at each of the twelve vertices, giving the symbol {5/2, 5}.

chapters.label: 03 / TOPOLOGY
chapters.title: An Euler count of -6
chapters.body: For this abstract face structure, V - E + F = 12 - 30 + 12 = -6, unlike a convex solid's 2.
